findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: REFERENCE-frame.html, index.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.

findings.message: data-composition-src references "compositions/frames/intro.html", but the file does not exist.
findings.fixHint: Fix this before rendering: the render pre-flight rejects unusable sub-compositions. Write valid HTML into "compositions/frames/intro.html". It needs a <template> or <body> containing an element with data-composition-id, data-width, and data-height. Preview/studio still tolerates and skips the scene while you author it. If a scene-authoring step is still running, wait for it to finish before referencing the file, or re-run the step that generates it.
